radius_note: About 60 miles. Distances below are straight-line miles from the ad pin or the seller city to College Station. Road miles are longer. Cars past about 60 straight-line miles are flagged as on the edge.

rules.included_only_if: A per-vehicle page was fetched and showed a price from $3,000 to $6,000. Salvage and rebuilt titles are excluded.
rules.history_rule: Owners, accidents, and title brand are recorded only when the fetched page states them. A Carfax button with no report text is not treated as a clean history.
rules.tires_rule: Tire notes are recorded only when the page mentions tires. Otherwise the value is 'unknown, check in person'.

lifespan_method.label: rough estimate
lifespan_method.what_the_study_measures: Chance a vehicle reaches 250,000 miles. The study's industry average is 4.8 percent. It is not a guaranteed odometer life for one car.
lifespan_method.model_notes: The same 2025 model table puts the Honda Civic at a 10.9 percent chance of 250,000 miles. Toyota Camry Hybrid is on that top-25 list at 10.2 percent. The gas Camry is not in the 2025 top 25. An older iSeeCars model table, on the brand article https://www.iseecars.com/articles/these-are-the-longest-lasting-car-brands, listed the gas Toyota Camry at 13.5 percent, the Ford F-150 at 15.8 percent, and the Chevrolet Tahoe at 17.7 percent. Those older model rates are labeled as the older table, not the 2025 table.
lifespan_method.how_estimates_were_set: Toyota, Lexus, and Honda reference point is 250,000 miles because those brands clear the study average by a wide margin. Scion xD is Toyota-built and is not on the 2025 top-25 list, so its estimate is 220,000. Mazda3 is estimated at 200,000: the car is simple, and the 2025 Mazda brand odds of hitting 250,000 (3.6 percent) are below the 4.8 percent average, so it is not scored like a Camry. Nissan compacts are estimated at 180,000 if the listing says manual, and 150,000 if the car is the CVT years. Hyundai and Kia of this era are estimated at 170,000. Cruze 1.4 turbo at 160,000. Full-size trucks and Tahoes at 250,000 using the older model table. G37 at 200,000 as a model estimate, with the Infiniti brand rate called out as lower. Jeep, Chrysler, and Dodge at 150,000. Subaru Outback at 200,000. Mitsubishi Raider at 160,000.

score_scale: Each category is 1 to 5. Overall is 0.30*miles + 0.30*price + 0.20*history + 0.20*condition, rounded to one decimal. Rank is by that value score, with local cars preferred when scores are close.
